title: mcp.tool.TaskSupport
description: The tool's preference for task-augmented execution.

anyOf.title: Required
anyOf.description: Clients MUST invoke the tool as a task.

anyOf.title: Optional
anyOf.description: Clients MAY invoke the tool as a task or normal request.

anyOf.title: Forbidden
anyOf.description: Clients MUST NOT attempt to invoke the tool as a task.
